name: screenshot-yashahime-battle

section.boundaryEvidence: Records 0–16 are Yashahime's battle responses; 17 is her postbattle realization and recruitment request; 18 repeats the request after refusal; 19 is acceptance thanks. Records 20–25 switch to the separate money-reward sequence: そーれ！, まだまだ あげるぞー！, ウヒャヒャ…！ まだまだ！, いつもより 多めに！, ほんじゃまか ホイホイ！, then 合計 [0a]両 手に入れた！ and the ３２回の ごほうび dialogue. No records from that next sequence are included.

validationNotes: Complete the tightly coupled 20-record Yashahime section, records 0–19 only. The containing 231-record block remains partial. Existing draft records 3 and 16 are unchanged; this follow-up adds 18 previously uncovered source records.
Screenshots 91, 92 and 93 are successive portions of the same source record 16, not three separate records.
Screenshots 94, 95 and 96 are successive portions of live postbattle record 17 at 0x7f8ae, not the related regional record 0x701f8:19.

Reuse wording from ice-tower-yashahime records 19–22 for shared postbattle prose, but not their control streams: live records 17–19 have different line/pause controls, dynamic 11 name references, and additional paragraphs. The combat-realization paragraph and request to tell the other oni are translated here as well.

Original glyphs were rendered from the SHA-verified Japanese source and visually read. Static dictionary 02:c9 is わたし and is translated as 我; it is not a dynamic actor name. The original kana-mode 04/03 pairs remain recorded in originalHex and must be preserved during future integration.

Source SHA, bounds, offsets, original bytes, ordered meaningful controls and 14-glyph line widths are checked without building a ROM. Name marker 11 is tested with five glyphs; this is a test budget, not proof of the runtime naming limit. compileTextDraft does not support sourceType 0; no integration or runtime verification is claimed.
